bias.zh: 区间整理 · 跌破 100 日和 200 日均线，守住 $619–620

read.en: Meta fell 2.4% on Nov 16 to $626.41, trading $620.14–640.70 on light volume (0.48x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($632.4), 10-day ($627.0), 30-day ($665.2, falling), 100-day ($637.8) and 200-day ($630.3). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram steady; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 9 ($597.87), and RSI is 43.9.

The drop gave back the 100 and 200-day reclaimed on Nov 13, now resistance with the 5 and 10-day; the $620.14 low held the Nov 12 low ($618.92). Resistance is $627–632.4, then $637.8–643.9 (100-day, Nov 13 and 16 highs) and $647.3–648.5. Support is $618.9–620.1, then $605.1–610.2 (Nov 5–6 closes) and $597.9 (SAR). A close above $632.4 would target $638–644; below $618.9, $605–610.
